name: Frax Price Index
oneLiner: FPI is Frax's retired inflation-indexed unit of account: FIP-448 froze its reference price, ended bridging, and left FRAX redemption on Ethereum.
collateral: Legacy-FRAX-linked balances and AMO/liquidity positions. The design targets a 100% collateral ratio and describes FPIS sales when AMO yield falls short of CPI; that target does not establish a 100% liquid FRAX reserve composition.
pegMechanism: The documented design applies the monthly CPI-U inflation input to an on-chain reference price and allows redemption into legacy FRAX through the Controller Pool. FIP-448, approved in June 2026, mandates an orderly wind-down: frozen reference price, no new minting, Ethereum redemptions open.

obituary.epitaph: Frax froze the CPI peg and wound down FPI
obituary.obituary: Frax launched FPI in March 2022 as an inflation-indexed unit of account whose redemption price tracked the U.S. CPI-U index through the FPI Controller Pool and FPIS governance token. Supply peaked near $114.0M before declining to roughly $7.0M by 2026. On June 17, 2026 Frax governance proposed FIP-448 to wind down the FPI system, and the Snapshot vote closed unanimously on June 28, 2026 (26.59M For, 0 Against). FIP-448 permanently froze FPI's CPI reference price, disabled new minting and LayerZero bridging, folded FPI's remaining balance sheet into Legacy FRAX, and left Ethereum redemptions into FRAX open.
